name: VRMExMR
description: Video in, VRM Animation out: ExMR reconstructs the body, hand and foot motion of the person in the clip, and the worker bakes it into a .vrma you can play on any VRM avatar.
overview: ExMR (Meta + TU Munich) recovers metric 3D motion from an ordinary clip: YOLO11 tracks the person, Sapiens2-1B or RTMW gives the 2D keypoints, SAM 3D Body samples body features, HaMeR refines the hands and SimpleVO recovers the camera motion, and the released checkpoint turns all of it into SMPL-X parameters with feet that stay on the ground. This cartridge runs that pipeline with the UI's own options and then does what the browser UI does on export — it retargets the result onto the VRM humanoid and bakes the bone rotations into a VRM Animation (.vrma), the avatar-independent format three-vrm plays on any avatar. The BVH ExMR writes comes back with it. Select a video layer, choose the options, then Run.

parameters.name: input_video
parameters.label: Source Clip
parameters.description: The clip to capture. The selected video layer is uploaded here automatically.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.label: Mode
parameters.description: Fast: YOLO11m + RTMW-x. Balanced: YOLO11m + Sapiens2-1B. Accurate: YOLO11x + Sapiens2-1B at 1024x768.

parameters.name: static_cam
parameters.label: Static Camera
parameters.description: The camera does not move. Switch off to estimate its motion (slower, and the world-frame travel depends on it).

parameters.name: snap_to_ground
parameters.label: Snap to Ground
parameters.description: Assume one flat ground: removes the vertical drift that makes long clips fly or sink.

parameters.name: root_motion
parameters.label: Root Motion
parameters.description: Write the hips translation into the .vrma, so the avatar travels with the person. Off keeps it in place.

parameters.name: start
parameters.label: Start
parameters.description: Only from this time on: seconds (83.5) or [hh:]mm:ss (1:23.5). Empty starts at the beginning.

parameters.name: end
parameters.label: End
parameters.description: Only up to this time. Empty runs to the end of the clip.

parameters.name: export_fps
parameters.label: Animation FPS (0 = video)
parameters.description: Resample the animation, e.g. 24 for film or 60 for games.

parameters.name: fps30
parameters.label: Resample to 30 fps
parameters.description: ExMR is trained on 30 fps; try it for 50/60 fps clips.

parameters.name: f_mm
parameters.label: Focal Length (mm, 0 = auto)
parameters.description: 35 mm equivalent focal length of the camera, if known.
